subject: general
question: Out of four brothers, M, N, O and P, M and N play cricket and football, N and O play cricket and hockey, O and P play hockey and basketball, P and M play football and basketball. Who plays football, basketball and hockey?
solution:
**Brothers :** M, N, O and P

1) M and N play cricket and football.

2) N and O play cricket and hockey.

3) O and P play hockey and basketball.

4) P and M play football and basketball.

According to statements:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/699f2f2b6fc3469e731e728103c5ff43fea58d880858b1c7312f63573a9502ce.png] 

**P **plays football, basketball and hockey.

Hence,** 'option 1'** is the correct answer.
